posts.text: The alliance with Nauru has nothing to do with importing goods to Nauru. The alliance is with Nauru airlines, which flies cargo in the Australia region. The relationship with Nauru began when Afcom leased their 3rd aircraft from Nauru airlines. Then they decided to strengthen the relationship further - Afcom would feed into Nauru’s planes using Indonesia ( or Malaysia, don’t remember exactly) as a hub and Nauru will forward the cargo to Australia and surrounding areas.
